question: '2G Saga Unfolds' book was written by _________
solution:
Correct Answer **Andimuthu Raja**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2G Saga** refers to a **major corruption** **scandal** that **unfolded in India in 2008**, involving the **allocation of 2G (second-generation)** telecom spectrum licenses.
 
• It was one of the **biggest corruption scandals in Indian history** and had far-reaching consequences.
 
• **Andimuthu Raja** is an Indian politician who was a central figure in the** 2G spectrum allocation scandal**.
 
• He was the** Minister of Communications and Information Technology** in the **Government of India from 2007 to 2010.**
 
• Raja, a member of the **Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) political party,** played a key role in the allocation of 2G spectrum licenses at significantly undervalued prices, leading to allegations of corruption and irregularities.
